summary: Legal Invoice Review step 3, Approve Treatment. Adds the 'approved' review state (locked against draft saves; approved_revision/by/at), a 'bedrock_corporate' allocation classification, review events for approval / posting / reversal / reopen, and legal_invoice_postings: one row per posted allocation linking the AP invoice line(s), journal entry and homeowner ledger charge, with a partial unique index allowing one live posting per allocation (the idempotency control). Approval and every posting claim commit in one transaction (legal_review_approve); claims are worked under a lease (legal_posting_claim); unique indexes on the bill-back journal entry and the owner charge / correction per posting are the database backstop; a pending claim that cannot finish can be cancelled. Replaces legal_review_save_draft (same body as 474 plus an approved_locked refusal) and adds legal_review_approve / legal_review_reopen. Changes no existing row; posts nothing.

expected_changes: legal_invoice_reviews: status CHECK widened to draft / approved; adds approved_revision, approved_by, approved_at (nullable) and legal_review_approved_shape (an approved review names its approver, time and the exact revision approved).
legal_invoice_review_events: action CHECK adds treatment_approved, posting_recorded, posting_reversed, review_reopened.

Creates legal_invoice_postings (review, allocation, item, AP invoice, AP line ids, community, revision, kind homeowner_chargeback / bedrock_recovery, property, amount > 0, debit/credit accounts, posting date, status pending / posted / reversed, journal entry, homeowner transaction, reversal entry + owner adjustment + reason + who/when). FKs RESTRICT. Shape CHECKs: a homeowner chargeback names a property; posted carries its entry (and owner charge); reversed carries the reversal, reason, who and when. Partial unique index: one pending/posted row per allocation. RLS on; nothing for anon / authenticated; SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE to service_role.
Replaces legal_review_save_draft: identical to 474 plus a refusal ('approved_locked') for an approved review.

Adds legal_review_approve (locks the exact revision the approver saw and inserts every posting claim in the same transaction, each checked against its active allocation's kind, amount, property and owner tenure; re-approving the same revision is a no-op success) and legal_review_reopen (only once every posting is reversed; reason of 5+ characters on the audit trail). EXECUTE to service_role only.

Adds legal_posting_claim (a 10-minute lease per posting row: one worker at a time; a lapsed lease may be taken over). Adds partial unique indexes uq_journal_entries_ap_billback_source (one posted ap_billback entry per source_reference), uq_homeowner_txn_legal_posting and uq_homeowner_txn_legal_posting_reversal (one owner charge / one owner correction per posting). legal_invoice_postings also carries tenure_id (the owner approved), claim_token / claimed_at, and a 'cancelled' status with its own shape CHECK.
No existing row changes; no posting, journal entry or homeowner charge is written.
